C
ClownBrother
last month

These are some i found (some i have read and others just the beginning).
Wuxia: "Beyond the Timescape" written by Er Gen, "Night Without End"

Tamer Novels: "I am Just an Average Tamer" just began this but seems interesting, "The First Legendary Beast Master" very slice of life but is a very good read, where it explores a world that used to have a system.

Just an Extra Novels: "Power of Runes" just read the beginning to get a feel for it seems like a good read, "Hunter Academy: Revenge of the Weakest" and the authors other work "Shattered Innocence: Transmigrated Into a Novel as an Extra" both have a fun power system with the "extra" finding their way in the main char world, and trying to survive this harsh world.

A little Horror and Mystery Novels: "Deep Sea Embers" very good mystery novel with alittle spice of horror, "Witch, I'm really not the Deep Sea Ancient God!" similar vein as the other one but a little more casual and a little clearer power system.

Avatar Novels (where Mc controls something else and gains power): "Longevity Martial Arts: I have a Mysterious Water Snake Avatar" havent begun this yet but seems like a fun read, "Mythical Era: My Evolution into a Celestial Beast" have read this one and its pretty good.
